title: Broccoli Cheese Stuffed Chicken Breast
blurb: Microwaving the broccoli first keeps the filling from weeping water into the pocket while the chicken sears.
steps: Season both sides of the chicken breasts with salt, pepper, paprika and half the garlic powder. Cut a slice through the middle of each breast, not all the way through, to create a pocket.

Microwave the broccoli with about 2 tablespoons of water, covered, for 1 minute; drain any excess water. Add the bell pepper, cheese, mayo, remaining garlic powder, and salt and pepper to taste; mix until combined. Divide the mixture between the chicken breasts, using a toothpick to secure if necessary.

Heat the olive oil in a large, oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Sear the chicken 3 to 4 minutes per side. Cover the skillet with foil and bake 15 to 17 minutes, until the chicken reads 165°F. Let rest, covered, 5 minutes before serving — these are large breasts, so half a breast is a reasonable serving.
